done.aliveTitle: Thank You — Owner Marked as Safe
done.aliveBody: This counts as a check-in on the owner's behalf: a new check-in cycle has started and the owner has been notified.
done.unreachableTitle: Thank You — Digital Executor Has Been Notified
done.unreachableBody: We have recorded your confirmation and notified the owner's designated Digital Executor to begin the legal verification process.
done.errorTitle: Confirmation Link Could Not Be Verified
done.errorGeneric: This confirmation link is no longer valid.
done.errorHint: If the owner still needs your confirmation, please use the most recent email from LegacyVault.

confirm.title: Is the owner safe?
confirm.intro: The owner of these vaults has not checked in, and their grace period has ended. They named you as a trusted confirmer. Please tell us whether you can reach them. Nothing has changed yet; your answer is only recorded when you press a button.
confirm.aliveButton: The owner is safe (check in for them)
confirm.unreachableConfirmBody: This immediately notifies the owner's executor to begin the handover and cannot be undone.
confirm.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Please open the most recent email from LegacyVault.
confirm.hint: If you are unsure, choose "The owner is safe": the owner will be reminded to check in.
